Definition: Machath, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Machath is the name of two Levites, and the verses keep them distinct. 1 Chronicles 6:35 names a Mahath son of Amasai in the line of the singers, and 2 Chronicles 29:12 names Mahath the son of Amasai among the Levites who rose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah, while 2 Chronicles 31:13 names a Mahath among the overseers of the offerings.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that names like this one matter because God keeps the record of servants nobody else would remember.
